title: Rahul Gandhi and Congress Leaders Detained Amid Protests in Delhi, Judicial and Political Controversies
summary: Rahul Gandhi and his fellow Congress leaders were detained by the police after protesting at PM’s residence in Delhi, with the government contesting the incidents and highlighting judicial oversight. Protests included demands for the PM’s resignation and criticism of allegations of misuse of political privileges. The government contested the protests and emphasized the role of judicial oversight in addressing the allegations.

sources.title: Police register FIR to probe violence during CJP's July 20 protest
sources.description:
The Crime Branch of the Delhi Police has registered an FIR to investigate the violence that broke out during the Cockroach Janta Party's (CJP) protest in the national capital on July 20, police sources said on Thursday.
The probe will focus on identifying people allegedly responsible for the violence and examine whether it was premeditated, the sources said.
On the directions of the Supreme Court, the Delhi Police had cancelled 17 FIRs registered at multiple police stations in the New Delhi district.
The FIR comes two days ahead of another CJP protest announced to be held at Jantar Mantar, this time to press for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the SIR exercise. A police officer said that permission has not been granted for any protest.
Referring to the fresh FIR, the police source told PTI that teams of the Crime Branch will also look into whether criminal elements entered the protest sites after the CJP called for a march

sources.title: Congress trying to create 'anarchy' in India like Nepal, Bangladesh: BJP
sources.description:
The BJP on Thursday alleged that the Congress is trying to create "Nepal- and Bangladesh-like anarchy" in the country through its street protests, as Rahul Gandhi is "desperate" to come to power.
Showing some video footage of INDIA bloc' Wednesday protest, BJP spokesperson Pradeep Bhandari said the way Rahul, his sister Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and Congress workers manhandled the police personnel in Delhi makes the party's intention clear.
"The Congress party's strategy is to spread anarchy in India, like Nepal and Bangladesh," he said in a video message.
Overlaying a purported video of the Congress protest, Bhandari said, "Congress party workers are seen trying to assault police personnel with kicks and punches. The policeman is performing his duty there, but a Congress worker pushes him and then kicks him."

sources.title: Delhi Police books Rahul, Priyanka for alleged 'assault', 'obstruction'
sources.description:
Delhi Police has registered an FIR against Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra for allegedly assaulting police personnel and obstructing government work during their protest here, police sources said on Thursday.
Besides several Congress leaders, the FIR has been filed against party workers who took part in the protest
The case was registered in connection with the incidents that took place during the Congress protest here on Wednesday. Police are examining the allegations and the role of those involved, the sources said.
Police said a total of 91 people were detained during the protest, including multiple MPs and leaders.
Rahul Gandhi led the INDIA bloc leaders' street protests on Wednesday before being detained again along with many MPs by police.

sources.title: Delhi Police seeks removal of 11 posts over 'misleading' protest content
sources.description:
The Delhi Police has asked a social media platform to remove or restrict access to 11 posts and videos allegedly presenting a misleading account of police action during a recent protest in the national capital, saying the content could provoke public reaction and adversely affect law and order.
The Joint Commissioner of Police, Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (IFSO), issued the notices on Monday under the Information Technology Act, 2000, directing the platform to remove or disable access to the reported URLs within three hours of receiving the intimation.
The action comes in the backdrop of the arrest of a 24-year-old man for allegedly circulating an AI-generated video falsely portraying a police officer as sexually assaulting a woman.
Police have said they are probing whether the circulation of the fabricated content was part of a larger conspiracy to malign the Delhi Police and create dissatisfaction during protests.
